title: ClientConfigRequest
description:
The request for the client configuration.

Introduced in VPP License Management 2.0.

mdmInfo.description: This value is returned by the server on all subsequent responses, and MDM uses it to ensure that no other MDM manages the same organization.

notificationAuthToken.description: The bearer token that the server provides in the Authorization header of notifications. This is a shared secret between you and the server to verify that incoming notifications are from Apple.

notificationTypes.description: The complete set of notification types to which MDM subscribes.

notificationUrl.description: The URL to which subscribed notifications POST. This URL should only include a host and path.
